validation: All 11 original leaflet-map-click coordinate pairs reproduce the distance in the corresponding valid-run report to its displayed rounding. Camera/spawn coordinates were used only to recompute distance and were never substituted for predictions.
limitations: No claim that all 75 numeric guesses survived.
These are map-pin coordinates recorded from the agent-selected UI, not numeric coordinates spoken by the agent.
The 59 invalid canonical records captured advertising consent data as outgoing-request coordinates; those numeric values are not treated as predictions.
Five canonical rounds have no recoverable numeric record, including the three-round Medium continuation.
Run 1 Hard and Run 3 Medium are composites documented in original reports. Contaminated and unfinished attempts are excluded.
Earlier globe exclusion remains unchanged; no automatic visualization import is made.
